verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the S&E API docs saying you can "manage transactions & reimbursements," which confirms reimbursements exist as a product capability but nothing about the employee experience. The remaining items cover AP vendor payments, cards, and webhooks, not employee reimbursement. missing for 10: employee out-of-pocket expense submission flow, direct-deposit payout to employees, payout timing ("in days"), submission-to-payout status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
